name: Vagrant Survival [0.9]
desc:
Drifters break into an old evacuated valley, unknowingly trapped in an experiment
Fight others to survive, loot abandoned structures to craft weapons and armor

Be sure to give us a like 👍⭐️ and join the group too for the Trapper Hat Blueprint! (Gem category of crafting)

[G] - Inventory
[B] - Build
[T] - Teams
[V] - Special Shop
[M] - Map

Exiting the game while in combat will result in your character dying, losing Weapons, Armor, and Medical items!
